reasons.symlink: A symbolic link. Goptimizer only rewrites real files, never what a link points to.
reasons.not_regular_file: Not a regular file, such as a device or a named pipe.
reasons.hard_link: The file has more than one hard link. Replacing it would split it from its other names.
reasons.access_control_list: The file has a POSIX access list, which a new file could not keep. It may be what lets the web server read it.
reasons.wrong_content: The content is not a PNG, JPEG or GIF, whatever its extension says.
reasons.apng: Animated PNG: quantizing would drop the animation.
reasons.too_many_pixels: Over 50 megapixels: too big to check safely in memory.
reasons.unreadable: The file or its directory could not be read, or the image header could not be decoded.
reasons.already_optimized: Goptimizer wrote these bytes before, at another path: the file was moved or copied. An image is never compressed lossily twice, so it is left as it is.
reasons.too_new: Younger than the folder's minimum age, so it may still be uploading. It is taken once it is old enough.
reasons.changed_while_optimizing: The file changed while it was being optimized, so the result was thrown away. The new version is optimized next.
reasons.interrupted: The service stopped while optimizing it. It is tried again.
reasons.tool_missing: A program this format needs is not installed. The image waits until it is.
reasons.tool_failed: A compression tool crashed, exited with an error or ran past its time limit.
reasons.swap_failed: The smaller file could not replace the original. The original is unchanged.
reasons.no_saving: The result was not smaller by at least the folder's minimum saving.
reasons.format_changed: The result came out in another format.
reasons.result_undecodable: The result could not be decoded.
reasons.dimensions_changed: The result has another width or height.
reasons.frames_changed: The result has a different number of frames.
reasons.animation_changed: The loop count or frame delays changed, so the animation would play differently.
reasons.pixels_changed: Some pixels differ from the original, which a lossless result must never do.
reasons.ssim_below_threshold: The result looks too different from the original: its similarity (SSIM) is below the folder's minimum.
reasons.color_changed: The color of an area shifted more than allowed: the result would look tinted or faded.
reasons.metadata_changed: The result lost or changed data browsers draw it with, such as the color profile or the orientation.
